connector.name: Revolut MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Revolut Business API: accounts, transactions, payments, FX, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package revolut-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jeff-nasseri account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: REVOLUT_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID from the Revolut Business portal (Settings -> APIs)

env.name: REVOLUT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
env.description: Path to the PEM private key that signs the client-assertion JWT

env.name: REVOLUT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: PEM contents of the private key (alternative to REVOLUT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH)

env.name: REVOLUT_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: OAuth redirect URI registered with the certificate (default: https://example.com/)

env.name: REVOLUT_JWT_ISS
env.description: JWT issuer; defaults to the redirect URI host
